description: This file defines the CustomerGroup model class within the Opencart Catalog module, providing methods to retrieve customer group data from the database.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching customer group data from the database, including individual customer group records and lists of customer groups.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific customer group record by ID from the database, including associated descriptions in the current language.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all customer group records available in the database, with descriptions ordered by sort order and name.
